svg.title: All 37 building profiles
svg.desc: Thirty-seven silhouettes drawn from the radius bytes of the profile table, one panel per record type, with the profile length beneath. Dockable types are ringed.
svg.text: The 37 shapes, painted from the profile tables
Every profile byte is a cylinder radius: the low six bits give it, the top two bits select a blink phase.
Type number · profile length in rows. Scale is uniform: the shapes are drawn with the same radius units as the projection uses.
